discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological role in glucose and appetite regulation, enabling GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has had a huge clinical and societal impact through semaglutide and related drugs. It won the Lasker Award in 2024 and other major prizes, and the 2025 Medicine prize went to peripheral immune tolerance, so GLP-1 is still the leading unawarded candidate. Habener, Mojsov and Drucker are the most widely recognized trio for identifying active GLP-1 and its insulinotropic and physiological effects.
